gain.label: Level
gain.hover: The overall loudness of the sound. Range 0.1 to 100.

pres_lin.label: Dynamics (even)
pres_lin.hover: The even part of how pressure becomes loudness: more here and a light touch already speaks. Range 0 to 1.

pres_sq.label: Dynamics (curved)
pres_sq.hover: The curved part of how pressure becomes loudness: more here and the loud end opens up faster than the soft end. Range 0 to 1.5.

pres_hz.label: Response
pres_hz.hover: How quickly the sound follows a change of pressure: low is a slow swell, high is immediate. Range 2 to 200 Hz.

release.label: Release
release.hover: How long the sound takes to die away after the key is released. Range 0.005 to 1 s.

rel_pedal.label: Release with pedal
rel_pedal.hover: How much longer the release gets with the sustain pedal down. Range 0 to 3 s.

p_soft.label: Breath, soft
p_soft.hover: The blowing pressure at the lightest touch, relative to where the tone just speaks: above 1 it always speaks, below 1 a light touch is only air. Range 0.8 to 2.

g_loud.label: Breath, loud
g_loud.hover: The blowing pressure at a full press, relative to the reed's closing pressure: higher is louder and more driven. Range 0.3 to 1.4.

g_reg.label: Breath by register
g_reg.hover: How the full-press blowing pressure changes per octave up: above 0 the high notes get more air. Range -0.5 to 0.5.

p_curve.label: Breath curve
p_curve.hover: The shape of the curve from key pressure to blowing pressure: below 1 soft playing is easier, above 1 the loud end comes later. Range 0.3 to 3.

zeta.label: Reed opening
zeta.hover: How open the reed is: higher is louder and freer, lower is tighter. Range 0.05 to 1.2.

zeta_reg.label: Opening by register
zeta_reg.hover: How the reed opening changes per octave up. Range -1 to 1 octaves.

reed_hz.label: Reed resonance
reed_hz.hover: Where the reed's own resonance sits. Range 500 to 6000 Hz.

reed_q.label: Reed damping
reed_q.hover: How much the lips damp the reed: low is damped and smooth, high is free and edgy. Range 0.05 to 1.2.

lay.label: Lay
lay.hover: How stiff the reed is against the mouthpiece when shut. Range 0 to 12.

emb.label: Embouchure by timbre
emb.hover: How much timbre firms the embouchure: up tightens the reed. Range -1.5 to 1.5 octaves.

emb_bend.label: Pitch by timbre
emb_bend.hover: How far the embouchure pulls the pitch as timbre moves. Range -100 to 100 cents.

bore_r.label: Bore radius
bore_r.hover: How wide the tube is: the wall losses. Range 3 to 20 mm.

wall.label: Wall losses
wall.hover: How much the tube's walls soak up: higher is darker and softer. Range 0 to 5.

lat_hz.label: Tone-hole cutoff
lat_hz.hover: The frequency above which the open tone holes stop reflecting: the wind tone's brightness. Range 300 to 5000 Hz.

lat_q.label: Cutoff sharpness
lat_q.hover: How sharp the tone-hole cutoff is. Range 0.3 to 0.7.

reg_pos.label: Register hole position
reg_pos.hover: How far the register hole sits from the reed. Range 0.03 to 0.42 m.

reg_tau.label: Register hole inertance
reg_tau.hover: How sluggish the register hole is: its effect on the upper register's tone. Range 0.1 to 10 ms.

reg_r.label: Register hole resistance
reg_r.hover: How much the register hole resists the air. Range 0 to 2.

alt_rel.label: Altissimo from
alt_rel.hover: How many semitones above the lowest note the altissimo register starts. Range 19 to 40 semitones.

tone_hz.label: Tone
tone_hz.hover: The brightness of the radiated tone: the frequency above which it rolls off. Range 1000 to 20000 Hz.

tone_q.label: Tone sharpness
tone_q.hover: How sharp the tone roll-off is. Range 0.5 to 2.

breath.label: Breath noise
breath.hover: The audible breath in the tone. Range 0 to 1.

breath_mod.label: Breath pulsing
breath_mod.hover: Whether the breath noise follows the pulses of the tone (1) or the steady flow (0). Range 0 to 1.

breath_hp.label: Breath colour
breath_hp.hover: The frequency below which the breath noise is cut: 0 none. Range 0 to 4000 Hz.

wander.label: Breath wander
wander.hover: How unsteady the breath is: the slow and fast fluctuation of a sustained tone. Range 0 to 0.2.

t_noise.label: Tongue "t"
t_noise.hover: The short noise burst of a tongued start. Range 0 to 1.

t_len.label: Tongue "t" length
t_len.hover: How long the "t" burst lasts. Range 0.001 to 0.05 s.

t_gate.label: Tongue "t" gate
t_gate.hover: How much the reed speaking silences the "t": 0 not at all, 1 the "t" sounds only before the tone. Range 0 to 1.

breath_pre.label: Air before the tone
breath_pre.hover: The hiss before the reed speaks, relative to the breath noise: an air attack. Range 0 to 4.

tongue.label: Strike
tongue.hover: How much a hard strike sharpens the start: the tongue's hold and release, the accent and the "t". Range 0 to 2.

tongue_noise.label: Tongue noise
tongue_noise.hover: How much "t" a hard strike adds at the start of the note. Range 0 to 2.

acc_level.label: Accent
acc_level.hover: The extra push at the start of a struck note: 0 none, higher is a sharper attack. Range 0 to 1.

acc_decay.label: Accent length
acc_decay.hover: How long the accent lasts before the note settles. Range 0.01 to 0.3 s.

tongue_t.label: Tongue release
tongue_t.hover: How long the tongue takes to let the note go on a soft start; a hard strike is many times faster. Range 0.001 to 0.05 s.

tongue_f.label: Tongue on the reed
tongue_f.hover: How hard the tongue pushes the reed shut on a tongued start. Range 0 to 4.

slur.label: Slur
slur.hover: How much articulation a legato note change gets: 0 seamless, 1 each new note is re-tongued. Range 0 to 1.

tune.label: Tune
tune.hover: A fine tuning offset. Range -100 to 100 cents.

pitch_t.label: Pitch settling
pitch_t.hover: How fast the player's ear pulls the pitch to its centre after a start or a change. Range 0.003 to 0.3 s.

instrument.label: Instrument
instrument.hover: Which instrument the engine plays; its lowest note sets where the registers lie. Range steps 0 to 1.
